heading: Affordable Housing
text: Vicki believes that everyone should have the opportunity to own a home. She is ready to fight for affordability in Orange County and help homeowners keep their homes.

heading: Infrastructure
text: Orange County needs to invest in local infrastructure today in order to meet the needs of tomorrow. This includes improving our roads, sidewalks, stormwater drainage, and local parks.

heading: Green Spaces
text: Orange County’s parks bring our community together. They also help shape the future of our community. Vicki is committed to increasing youth recreation to ensure Orange County has an even brighter future.

heading: County Services
text: From upgrading public transportation to increasing accessible healthcare, Vicki Vargo is ready to fight for us. Why? Because Orange County deserves quality county services!

heading: Vicki Vargo Is A Change Agent
text: Vicki Vargo is a second-generation American and a proven change agent in Orange County — someone who doesn’t just talk about change, but delivers it. Inspired by grandparents who escaped oppression in Hungary, Vicki learned early the importance of integrity, community, and standing up for what’s right.

heading: Vicki Vargo Is A Change Agent
text: From expanding access to affordable housing — including townhomes, condominiums, and duplexes for first-time homeowners — to rooting out government waste and ensuring responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars, Vicki has spent decades fighting for Central Florida families.

heading: Experience That Delivers Results
text: Vicki brings real-world experience across government, law, and community leadership:

heading: Experience That Delivers Results
text: Former Orlando City Councilmember (District 3) As an Orlando City Commissioner, Vicki supported and assisted with bringing the FAMU law school to downtown Orlando. She believes in smart growth. Vicki agreed with purchasing the old Navy base land and worked with planners to create Baldwin Park, a model community reflecting what sustainable neighborhoods should look like. Vicki voted to promote several key public safety leaders: Jerry Demings as Chief of the Orlando Police Department and Charlie Walker as Chief of the Orlando Fire Department; and our current Orange County Sheriff, John Mina, to Orlando Police Chief. All of whom were duly qualified and the best persons for the job.

heading: Experience That Delivers Results
text: She represented residents for six years, fighting for affordability, accountability, and transparent local government while working closely with the Florida League of Cities. As an Orlando City Commissioner, Vicki took a hands-on approach to reviewing city finances. She learned the City’s budgeting and accounting systems, examined departmental spending, and identified areas of waste and inefficiency. With families facing rising costs and taxpayers demanding greater accountability, Vicki will make fiscal oversight and responsible stewardship of public funds a top priority on the Orange County Commission. She built both the Rosemont and College Park Neighborhood Centers in the same year!

heading: Experience That Delivers Results
text: Former Attorney for The Housing Authority of the City of Orlando Worked directly on housing and affordability issues impacting working families and vulnerable populations — experience that shaped her lifelong commitment to tackling homelessness and housing instability.

heading: Experience That Delivers Results
text: Real Estate & Housing Attorney (28+ years) Practiced real estate law at Aksell & Vargo, P.A., and previously served as Department Managing Attorney at Anderson & Rush, overseeing large-scale real estate, landlord-tenant, and mortgage foreclosure matters.

text: Vicki understands that a strong economy and responsible government go hand in hand. She was selected to participate in the Florida Chamber of Commerce’s Leadership Florida Local Government Leadership Program (Class X) , a statewide program that brings together business and local government leaders.

heading: Community Leadership
text: Board Member, Central Florida Fair & Expo Park (2000–Present) Vicki has served on the board of one of Central Florida’s longest-standing community institutions, supporting its role in agriculture, education, and events for everyone.

heading: Rooted in Central Florida
text: Outside of public service, Vicki enjoys agriculture, gardening, biking, and advocating for children with mental health conditions — keeping her grounded in the real needs of Orange County families.
